expansion.source_decision: Included after Methods2.3 and full TableS4 inspection; no truncation of values over100; ND not imputed.

expansion_round2.scope: Dunaliella total endpoints selected uniformly across conditions, matching prior Chlorella extraction. Individual analyte measurements retained separately, not selectively promoted by magnitude. Cereals broaden sensitivity scope only.

expansion_round3.scope: Targeted acquisition in smaller matrix categories; 24 leafy total means, 14 cereal analyte means, four native dairy graph estimates. No synthetic balancing, duplicate controls or model-outcome selection. Four cheese candidates remain outside cohorts: weak isolation and missing bile/lipase make compatibility unclear.
